name: feature
description: New feature in an existing application. Default playbook: few waves, Claude keeps the seams.
claude_keeps: change contract (what changes in API/model, what does not)

tasks.slice: one card: what changes in API/data model/UI, what must not change; acceptance commands
backend/logic per the contract, with tests
UI per the contract, only if the feature has UI (disjoint scope from backend)
second opinion on the implement diff when > 200 lines
glue, wiring, merge in id order

notes: Executors get self-contained leaves; Claude owns interfaces.
